name: features-15
description: Developer feature list beside a dark code window with language tabs and a copy button.

files.content:
"use client" import { useState } from "react" import { Check, Copy } from "lucide-react" import { cn } from "@workspace/ui/lib/utils" const snippets: Record = { TypeScript: `import { Ledger } from "@tallyhq/sdk" const ledger = new Ledger(process.env.TALLY_KEY) await ledger.charges.create({ amount: 4200, currency: "eur", customer: "cus_8fK2", idempotencyKey: order.id, })`, Python: `from tally import Ledger ledger = Ledger(os.environ["TALLY_KEY"]) ledger.charges.create( amount=4200, currency="eur", customer="cus_8fK2", idempotency_key=order.id, )`, Go: `client := tally.New(os.Getenv("TALLY_KEY")) _, err := client.Charges.Create(ctx, &tally.ChargeParams{ Amount: 4200, Currency: "eur", Customer: "cus_8fK2", IdempotencyKey: order.ID, })`, } const features = [ ["Typed end to end", "Generated SDKs with autocomplete for every field and error code."], ["Safe retries", "Idempotency keys on every write, so a flaky network never double-charges."], ["Test clocks", "Fast-forward subscriptions through a year of billing in seconds."], ] export default function Features15() { const langs = Object.keys(snippets) const [lang, setLang] = useState(langs[0]!) const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false) return (

For developers

Charge a card in eight lines.

    {features.map(([title, body]) => (
  • {title}

    {body}

    • ))}
{langs.map((l) => ( ))} 
            {snippets[lang]}
) }
